description: This source file defines the DeviceUser class, which implements the User interface from Vert.x for authorization purposes in an Eclipse Hono service. The class extends Device and provides methods for authorization checks, cache clearing, and setting an authentication provider.

classes.name: DeviceUser
classes.description: A class that implements the User interface for devices, enabling authorization validation in the context of the Hono service.

methods.name: DeviceUser
methods.description: Constructor creating a new DeviceUser instance with a tenant ID and device ID.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the device has a particular authority, completing the result via the handler.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Method intended to clear any cached authorization data; currently returns null.

methods.name: setAuthProvider
methods.description: Sets the authentication provider; no operation since JWT is self-contained.
